name: phase347-groq-allam-vault-http-error-redaction
probe_prompt: Return one raw JSON object only. First byte {; last byte }; no fences or extra text. The credential vault HTTP surface handles user validation errors and internal errors. Validation errors (short passwords, invalid secret names) emit HTTP 400 invalid_request. Internal I/O, corrupt file, or storage errors emit HTTP 500 internal_error with a generic message and redact internal filesystem paths. Domain status codes (401, 404, 409, 423) remain preserved. A model cannot unlock, bypass, or write state. Exact keys/types: validation_error_is_bad_request=true; internal_io_error_is_server_error=true; internal_error_message_redacted=true; file_path_not_leaked=true; domain_status_codes_preserved=true; model_authority=false; canonical_writes=0.
